guideline: Students take pre-test and post-test with fill-in-the-blank questions; improvement in scores is measured. They also rate the difficulty of the examples.

Participants completed a pre‑test and a post‑test consisting of fill‑in‑the‑blank multiple‑choice questions. Example sentences generated by each model were shown during the post‑test. Improvement was measured by comparing pre‑test and post‑test scores, and a questionnaire collected ratings of difficulty and usage of example sentences.
Students were asked to answer the same question sets in the post-test so we can measure the improvement they made between the pre-test and the post-test.
